elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance.
elements.evidence: The clause requires insurance including product liability insurance, but does not expressly require commercial general liability insurance.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance shall have a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability per-occurrence limit is stated.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance shall have an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability aggregate limit is stated.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.
elements.evidence: The added language requires RevMed to maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.

elements.element: Professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance shall have a limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added professional liability limit is only USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor shall maintain cyber/privacy liability insurance.
elements.evidence: The Customer Data condition is not demonstrably absent. Although the clause requires cyber liability insurance unconditionally, it does not expressly require privacy liability coverage.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber/privacy liability insurance shall have a limit of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The Customer Data condition is not demonstrably absent, and the stated cyber liability limit is only USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no express workers' compensation insurance requirement.

elements.element: Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The existing clause requires evidence of insurance upon request, but does not specifically require certificates of insurance.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.
elements.evidence: RevMed is expressly required to maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.

elements.element: Professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance shall have a limit of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added language sets the professional liability minimum at USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain cyber liability insurance.
elements.evidence: RevMed is expressly required to maintain cyber liability insurance.

elements.element: Cyber liability insurance shall have a limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added language sets the cyber liability minimum at USD 2,000,000.

result.reason: The operative redline cleanly adds the two fallback coverages and limits for RevMed without changing unrelated terms. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits specified CGL limits, the higher E&O and cyber/privacy limits, workers' compensation, and an express certificate requirement. Drafting quality is reduced because the added language does not specify the limit basis, policy period, or duration of the new minimums.
